name: Smart Mouse Gallery
description: Row of dimmed image tiles with a custom circular cursor that grows over a tile and shows an icon matching that tile, while the hovered image brightens and zooms.
contents: Row of image tiles, each tagged with a type and a Font Awesome icon class
Custom round cursor with an icon inside
behavior: Custom cursor follows the mouse with a smooth Web Animations transition
Cursor scales up and shows the tile icon when over a tile, hides the icon elsewhere
Hovered tile raises opacity and zooms its background image
Tiles wrap into rows below 1024px and stay in one row on large screens
editableByProps: Number of tiles, their images and cursor icons
Background, cursor color and size, zoom scale, animation duration, tile opacities

needsCodeEdit.change: Change tile aspect ratio or size
needsCodeEdit.where: aspect-[1/1.25] w-[clamp(150px,30vmin,500px)] classes on the items.map tile

fixed: Loads the Font Awesome stylesheet from a CDN when not already on the page and removes it on unmount if it added it
Custom cursor is hidden until the mouse enters the component and needs a mouse, so touch devices see only the tiles
Root is at least full viewport height
